summary: Trap: on 2026-11-16 the `latest` dist-tag of the `prisma` CLI points to 8.0.0-rc.33, a pre-release that GitHub marks prerelease, while @prisma/client latest is 7.10.1. `npm i -D prisma` therefore installs an RC that does not match the client. Pin prisma and @prisma/client to the same stable 7.x.
